caption: The drawing depicts a single lidded glass container, centered on a plain, light beige background. The container is characterized by an oval, bulbous body with a repeat raised oval pattern covering its exterior surface. It has a short, narrow stem that extends downward to a wide, round pedestal base. The container's lid mirrors the shape and pattern of the body and is topped with a small, knob-shaped finial. The overall coloration is primarily shades of soft gray, pale blue, and subtle hints of brown, which are used to illustrate the reflective and transparent qualities of glass. Shadows and highlights are utilized to suggest form and depth. The object appears to be a decorative or utilitarian jar, rendered with careful attention to the details of its texture and material. Near the base, the artist’s signature, "GEO. YANDSKO," is present.
title: Sugar Bowl
